solar_event.note: Whole-event absorbed dose if unprotected. In Gy; not added to radiation_dose_usv.

walking.v_flat_kmh.source: NASA Apollo planning value for walkbacks over 1 hour

walking.tobler_k.source: Tobler hiking function (1993), fitted to unsuited walkers on Earth; used for the slope shape only

walking.tobler_offset.source: Tobler hiking function (1993); cancels after normalising to 1 on flat ground

walking.gravity_m_s2.source: NASA Mars Fact Sheet (NSSDC), surface gravity

walking.leg_length_m.source: Team choice: typical adult leg length

walking.froude_walk_run.source: Walk-run transition at Froude number 0.5, Kram et al. 1997 (reduced-gravity locomotion)

constraints.slope_max_deg.source: Same as the red slope threshold in terrain/thresholds.toml (a starting value there)

constraints.cliff_buffer_m.source: Team choice: ring around over-limit slopes. Has no effect when below cell_m (the nearest neighbour is already one cell away); 0 turns it off

risk.yellow_rate.source: Team choice: a minute on yellow counts double at w = 1

risk.steep_onset_deg.source: Same as the yellow slope threshold in terrain/thresholds.toml

risk.steep_rate_max.source: disabled: yellow already encodes 10–20° slope; re-enable if Nahla changes yellow

risk.near_red_radius_m.source: Team choice: three cells at 5 m

risk.near_red_rate_max.source: Team choice: rate at distance 0 from a red cell, falling linearly to 0 at near_red_radius_m

profiles.w_fastest.source: Definition of the fastest profile: risk is ignored

profiles.sweep_w.source: Team choice: spans fastest to beyond safest

sensitivity.v_flat_kmh.source: 2.7: Apollo walkback planning value. 3.4: energy-optimal walking speed in Mars gravity, Cavagna et al. 1998

sensitivity.slope_max_deg.source: Team choice: 5 degrees either side of the limit

timeline.stop_order.source: Default until Zakiyyah decides whether routing may reorder stops

timeline.optimise_max_stops.source: Team choice: 8 stops is 40,320 orders, still fast; above this, optimise falls back to as_listed with a warning

timeline.stop_min_default.source: STOP_MIN in data/make_fake.py; to be replaced by the mission brief

timeline.ingress_min.source: Team choice, confirmed by Tushaar: time to get back inside at the start

timeline.eva_max_min.source: CONTRACT.md plan.json example; to be replaced by the mission brief

radiation.background_dose_rate_msv_day.source: Curiosity RAD (MSL) at Gale, Hassler et al. 2014; applied to Jezero

radiation.limit_usv.source: CONTRACT.md plan.json example; to be replaced by the mission brief

radiation.solar_event_dose_mgy.source: Curiosity RAD (MSL) at Gale, 20 May 2024, NASA; applied to Jezero. Stays in Gy

radiation.baseline_tolerance_pct.source: Team choice: warn when the radiation.csv median differs from the config rate by more

radiation.storm_detect_factor.source: Team choice: hours at or above this are listed as storm hours

shelter_map.colour_max_min.source: Same range as the fake layer in data/make_fake.py

track.spacing_m.source: Team choice: five cells at 5 m, enough for the slope profile

budget.destination_stop.source: Team choice (Tushaar): the one-way over-budget limit counts one stop of timeline.stop_min_default at the destination; false sets it to 0

landing.pad_radius_m.source: Team assumption (Tushaar), pending Nahla: radius of the circular lander pad that must be safe

landing.max_pad_slope_deg.source: Team assumption (Tushaar), pending Nahla: tilt of the best-fit plane through the pad's DEM cells

landing.max_roughness_m.unit: m (RMS of the DEM about the pad's best-fit plane)
landing.max_roughness_m.source: Team assumption (Tushaar), pending Nahla: half of the yellow (careful) roughness of 0.5 m in terrain/thresholds.toml [roughness], so a pad is clearly smoother than ground that is only walkable with care. Scale differs: terrain measures RMS about the local mean in a 5 x 5 cell (25 m) window on the 5 m grid; this is RMS about a plane over the whole pad (50 m across) on the same grid

landing.max_height_range_m.unit: m (highest minus lowest DEM cell on the pad, after removing the best-fit plane)
landing.max_height_range_m.source: Team assumption (Tushaar), pending Nahla: catches a single step, mound or pit that the RMS roughness averages away; not a sourced lander clearance

landing.hazard_clearance_m.source: Team assumption (Tushaar), pending Nahla: no red cell, over-limit slope cell or cliff-buffer cell this close to the pad centre

landing.marginal_pct.source: Team assumption (Tushaar): a pad that passes but is within this share of any limit is marked marginal

landing.ti_warn_below.source: terrain/thresholds.toml [thermal_inertia] yellow_below (loose sand; terrain's starting value, not checked against Jezero data). Used only for a warning flag, never a hard rule, and only while layers.json marks the thermal layer as real

landing.window_centre_m.unit: "site" (the centre of site.grid) or [x, y] in m on the site grid
landing.window_centre_m.source: Team choice: the export window is centred on the site

landing.window_size_m.unit: "full" (the whole site.grid) or [width, height] in m
landing.window_size_m.source: Team choice: the whole site grid of layers.json; a smaller window is for the future full-crater grid

landing.tile_size_m.unit: m (square tiles; whole cells; edge tiles are smaller)
landing.tile_size_m.source: Team choice: 1024 cells at 5 m, so the current 2 km site is one tile and a 9,000 x 9,000 cell grid would be 9 x 9 tiles

landing.display_safe_rgba.source: Team display choice (Tushaar): semi-transparent green for safe landing cells (code 0) in landing_zones.png

landing.display_marginal_rgba.source: Team display choice (Tushaar): semi-transparent amber for marginal landing cells (code 1) in landing_zones.png

escape.zone_codes.unit: mask codes (start.py): 2 red hazard, 3 slope over the limit, 4 cliff buffer, 5 sealed gap
escape.zone_codes.source: Team assumption (Tushaar): the blocked ground a crew may walk out of in an emergency; never 1 (no data: no slope, so no speed)

escape.risk_rate.source: Team assumption (Tushaar): every escape minute counts fully as risky; equal to the highest rate passable ground can reach (risk.yellow_rate, risk.near_red_rate_max), so a zone minute never counts as safer than the worst legal ground

escape.max_slope_deg.source: Team assumption (Tushaar): about the angle of repose of loose dry granular material, where walking becomes scrambling or sliding; not relaxed for Mars gravity (traction drops with g). Above it a cell cannot be walked out of even in an emergency

start.name: Demo start
start.source: demo start: the safe landing cell nearest the grid centre (routing/landing.py, [landing] thresholds in routing/config.toml); no --start was given
